title: Nutmeg Crisp Moroccan Green Pepper Tagine
description: A salty and crisp Moroccan dish featuring green pepper, made in a papillote and suitable for ovo-vegetarian diets
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the tops off the green peppers and remove the seeds and membranes.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, and ground nutmeg.
Stuff each green pepper with the onion and spice mixture and top with an egg.
Wrap each pepper in foil to create a papillote and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the peppers are tender and the eggs are cooked through.
